data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 篝火旁的晚餐分餐
data.description: 旅途营地，她跪坐在篝火边把炖菜分进每个人的碗里，尾巴被火光照得暖融融；确认大家都拿到之后才给自己盛，动作自然得像呼吸。

data.promptProse: Raphtalia kneels beside the travel campfire, dividing stew among her companions' bowls before serving herself. Her cream blouse and blue apron remain tidy above a long brown skirt, tail warmed by the nearby flames. The horizontal medium view includes the pot and waiting bowls across the camp circle. Firelight illuminates her ladle hand and ear edges, with orange reflections on bowl rims and longer moving shadows beyond the gathered diners.
